name: Nela Riehl - Considérant B - Am 19
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities – annual report 2026
part_text: B. whereas the European Pillar of Social Rights has no binding legal force and must not serve as a basis for extending the EU’s competences into areas reserved to the Member States under the Treaties; whereas social policy, wage-setting mechanisms and the organisation of social protection systems remain primarily national competences; whereas the European Semester must not evolve into a mechanism of centralised social surveillance or indirect social harmonisation; whereas full respect for the principle of subsidiarity and national diversity of social models must remain a cornerstone of economic governance within the EU;
